source_row.extraction_instructions: Umbraco event-search: cards are server-rendered (default filter = upcoming); date lines have no year for this year's events (year from URL slug or next occurrence). Load-more only appears above ~96 cards. Annual events (Winter Meeting, Congress) are empty shells on escrs.org: details come from the wintermeeting/congress microsites when they name the same year. Education events (Vision to Venture) reach public EUR ticket prices via /v2v/ page -> members.escrs.org/event/. Affiliated events link to the organiser (Outlook SafeLink unwrapped).

registry_comment: 132: ESCRS meetings & events: Umbraco event-search cards (plain HTTP), year-less dates resolved from URL/next occurrence, annual events enriched from the wintermeeting/congress microsites, Vision to Venture fees via members.escrs.org tickets

spot_check.site_says: 30th October - 1st November, Marriott Hotel Budapest; members.escrs.org tickets EUR 700 standard, EUR 500 Bring a Colleague, EUR 700 group ticket
17 to 20 March 2027, InterContinental CityStars, Cairo, Egypt (card says 'Eygpt'); Submit your abstract by 1 November; registration opens December 2026
15-19 October 2027, IFEMA, Madrid, Spain (congress.escrs.org calendar link 20271015-20271020)

concerns: Recon said JS load-more; the default 'upcoming' result set is server-rendered into the HTML (7 cards) and the load-more button is only emitted above ~96 cards (seen with ?DateRange=All). The browser click-through for that case is written but UNPROVEN: there is nothing to click for upcoming events today. Forced-fallback run (httpx 403) returned the same 5 shells via the browser.
Scope kept: shells beyond 800 days are dropped (47th/48th Congress, 2029/2030, date-only placeholders); the 46th Congress (6-10 Oct 2028) is kept with a generated one-line blurb and no venue.

Annual-event pages on escrs.org are empty shells (no text even in the browser); content comes from wintermeeting.escrs.org / congress.escrs.org, used only when the microsite text names the same year. No fees: winter meeting registration 'will open in December 2026', congress.escrs.org has no registration page (404). Instructional Course submission deadline (23 Oct 2026) is stored as abstract_deadline for the Congress; this is a course-proposal call, not an abstract call.
Affiliated Events (Hellenic congress) are listing-only: the card link (Outlook SafeLink, unwrapped) is kept as booking_url/organiser_url; the organiser page was not read. Its fees are not captured.

Vision to Venture: two-hop fee discovery (education page -> /v2v/vision-to-venture-budapest -> members.escrs.org/event/..., Tribe Tickets items). The group ticket row's EUR 700 is a list price; the page says eligible ESCRS members get EUR 500 at checkout (login). Members' fees behind login.
Card text has typos copied as-is where no microsite exists ('Marriot Hotel'); the Cairo 'Eygpt' typo is corrected from the microsite welcome text.
Event type: congress/meeting -> conference; education-events path or weekend/course words -> course. Vision to Venture Weekend 1 is typed course.
